Definition: from νέω (of like meaning); to spin:--spin.
BiblicalUsage: To spin is the work the lilies do not do. Jesus points to the lilies of the field — they toil not, neither do they spin — yet Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these, and the Father clothes them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the lilies preach a sermon I need: my Father dresses what never worked a day, and He will dress me too.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
